tests.fixture_reference: Public catalogue; anonymous context. Synthetic query or synthetic browser geolocation where described.
steps: Search for a known public event
Select its pin
Enter a synthetic nonsense phrase with Explore collapsed
Clear the query
tests.expected: Known match opens and a zero-match state explains how to recover

findings.user_impact: Guest discovery controls required refresh in one observed session.
findings.proposed_fix: Reproduce and diagnose the guest initialization path in a fresh session before changing it.
findings.design_guidance: Show loading and keyboard-accessible recovery. Preserve a clear route to discovery and service.
acceptance_checks: Fresh desktop and narrow guest sessions reach usable controls on first entry.
Refresh restores the same guest route.
Any stalled load gives actionable recovery feedback.
findings.observation: One desktop Chrome guest transition produced a blank cream screen with an empty accessibility tree. One refresh restored guest controls. Frequency, root cause and narrow-viewport impact are unknown.
findings.phase_2_disposition: Open. Blank first entry not reproduced in successful fresh desktop, 412 px and 390 px narrow sessions. A separate 390 px pass timed out waiting for the welcome control, then reached the public map on a later navigation. No blank screen was confirmed in that pass.
reproduction_steps: Open the canonical Connect URL in a fresh guest browser context.
Select Browse as Guest and observe Map, Search and Explore before any reload.
If the surface is blank, capture redacted evidence and reload once to test recovery.

findings.user_impact: A guest seeing an empty map can mistake zero matches for a load failure, or give up before clearing the query.
reproduction_steps: Open Search on the guest map.
Type a synthetic phrase with no matches while keeping the Explore panel collapsed.
The matched pin disappears. Look for a visible zero-results cue without expanding the panel. Use Clear search and confirm the pin returns.
findings.proposed_fix: Add a concise zero-results status next to the map search input and keep Clear search available. Distinguish empty results, loading and errors.
findings.design_guidance: Keep the map context visible and use plain language to help the guest return to discovery.
acceptance_checks: At 1280 and 390 CSS px, a zero-match query shows visible and screen-reader-readable feedback without opening another panel.
Clear search restores the unfiltered results.
A successful query and an in-progress load use distinct states.

provenance.attribution: Both aliases READY and both canonical Connect pages advertised the same browser bundle. Exact upstream deployment for the Hub request remains unverified.
